# Load the workbook for writing

# Sheet2 Column A contains the lookup keys.

    # Get the corresponding Deal Name from the mapping
    result_value = mapping.get(lookup_value, None)
    # Write the literal value to Column B
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=2).value = result_value

# Save the resulting spreadsheet
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/12864_0_eba51d48/1_12864_output.xlsx'
